title: Alex Eubank is throwing his life away
summary: Reacting to Alex Eubank announcing TRT, NH rejects his natural-limit and social-pressure excuses. He says 8 years is early intermediate, and that staying shredded year-round rather than bulking is what stalled Eubank. He criticises influencer irresponsibility, TRT clinics as a legal steroid loophole and the message this sends teenage viewers, and urges them to stop watching.
claims: Influencers who go on drugs always start with excuses meant to show it isn't their fault
Eight years natural is not long; most big natural bodybuilders he knows have trained at least 15 years
Anyone telling you gains stop after 3, 5, 8 or 10 years is lying, usually to justify their own drug use
Staying lean year-round for social media creates your own 'natural limit'; your physique stops changing because you don't give it what it needs
Chasing 'aesthetics' often means staying around 160 lb for years and wondering why you aren't progressing
Every natural bodybuilder who reaches 180-200+ lb spent years in a sizable surplus, not necessarily a dirty bulk
A physique is like a statue: if you only remove clay and never add any, you end up with a pebble
An aesthetic influencer's business model depends on staying shredded, which stops natural progress
When a successful natural influencer says natural isn't enough, teenagers conclude they should start drugs right away, and some are on testosterone within their first year
Public figures are their brother's keeper; influence brings responsibility for followers who copy you
Transformation videos of beginners on drugs are popular because teenagers live through them vicariously, and they inspire copycats
Feeling bad when shredded is normal; naturals should be lean only for a few weeks before a show and otherwise at maintenance or bulking
Only feeling comfortable when very lean is body dysmorphia, often fuelled by social media
Spending time with bigger enhanced peers breeds an inferiority complex; PED use is contagious
Benefits from a cycle don't stay: high libido on PEDs becomes very low libido once you come off
TRT clinics prescribe testosterone even to men with normal levels; it is a legal loophole for selling steroids, and customers become customers for life
Once you decide you can't grow without drugs, you have crossed a line and are likely to take more and more
Giving in to peer pressure to take steroids proves the haters right and shows you are malleable and immature
There is no healthy way to take steroids; bloodwork only shows so much
Enhanced bodybuilders die on average 20-30 years earlier than natural bodybuilders
Viewers are the algorithm: stop watching PED-promoting influencers and support natural creators
